messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — starting production deploy in 10m for release dpl-2026-03-20-42. This includes: pinning model-service to v2.3.1 for the canary, and a staggered FF change for `smart-cache` (off -> 10% -> 50% over 30m). Will monitor latency/error spikes.
kevin: 👍 who’s owning watch and rollback?
maria: tilly will take first 30m watch, oncall-ops backup if we need immediate revert. I’ll coordinate rollback playbook.
tilly: I’ll be on watch. Key metrics: p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, and cache hit ratio. If 5xx > 0.5% or p95 > 1.5x baseline for 3 consecutive mins, revert.
sam-dev: Can you paste the exact revert commands?
maria: Revert steps (quick):
```
# unpin model version
redwoodctl svc pin model-service --version v2.3.0 --deploy dpl-2026-03-20-42
# disable feature flag
redwoodctl ff set smart-cache off --env prod
# trigger drain on canary instances
redwoodctl instance drain --tag canary
```
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: dpl-2026-03-20-42 by maria. Canary batch scheduled in 8m.
qa-bot: Quick smoke after canary (chatgen + retrieval) — tests 1/12 passing baseline, will post results.
tilly: Canary deployed. FF smart-cache -> 10% traffic. Pin applied to model-service v2.3.1 for 5% of traffic.
maria: Observing metrics — p50 steady, p95 +5%, 5xx at 0.12%. Cache hit ratio up slightly. Holding for 10m before 50% shift.
kevin: Any logs of model OOMs or KV cache errors?
sam-dev: No OOMs. Saw one noisy warning during generation at 12:02 but no crash.
maria: QA smoke passed majority, one flaky retrieval case logged (ticket #5472). Not blocking. Proceeding to 50% at +12m unless tilly yells.
tilly: Proceed. I’ll keep close eye.
qa-bot: Canary smoke full results: 11/12 ok, flaky test reproduced once — linked in #testing.
oncall-ops: I’m standing by. Ready to run revert commands if threshold crossed.
maria: Shift to 50% now. Metrics updating...
deploy-bot: Canary -> 50% shift completed for smart-cache.
tilly: Seeing p95 spike to 1.6x at 3:15 after shift, but 5xx still 0.2%. Waiting for second window.
maria: If p95 stays >1.5x for 5m or 5xx >0.5% -> revert.
kevin: Agree. Set alert: `alert-prod-ff-degrade` to immediate page at 0.5% 5xx.
oncall-ops: Alert configured.
qa-bot: Additional regression: generation latency increased for specific long-context prompts, will add to regression dashboard.
maria: Noting that. If it persists after 20m, we’ll roll the flag back and roll forward a patched model or runtime tweak.
tilly: 20m elapsed, p95 trending back down to 1.2x, 5xx stable. No revert.
maria: Good. Closing canary -> schedule full ramp plan for tomorrow morning maintenance window. Will document steps in the release notes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
